title: Universal Parry
description: Now you can make blocking weapons !
body:
# **With this pack you can make blocking weapons !**

### **Stats:**

- Wood : block 1 damages and 30% of damages
- Stone : block 2 damages and 40% of damages
- Copper : block 2 damages and 40% of damages
- Iron : block 3 damages and 50 % of damages
- Diamond : block 4 damages and 60% of damages
- Netherite : block 5 damages and 70 % of damages
- Gold : block 2 damages and 50 % of damages , special : for magic damages gold block 6 damages and 80 % of damages , and gold has a radius of 360°
